sentence: This project tests a smartphone-based tool that tracks mood and behavior to support treatment of adolescent mood disorders.
This project studies breast cancer patients with residual disease after therapy and builds algorithms that predict their outcomes.
This project tries to find out which transcriptional regulators and molecular pathways activate cardiac fibroblasts in cardiac fibrosis.
This project studies how the skin and gut microbiome relate to the start of atopic dermatitis in infants.
This project uses mice to study how a genetic variant changes B cells and increases atherosclerosis.
This project uses machine learning to predict how T cell receptors recognize tumor antigens.
This project studies how inflammatory diseases increase the risk of psychiatric conditions.
This project builds a womb-like machine that gives mechanical, electrical, and biological signals to grow bioartificial ventricles.
This project tests a classifier that uses very small amounts of cyst fluid to improve diagnosis of pancreatic cystic lesions.
This project studies the rules that decide how proteins bind to DNA.
This project develops and tests therapies for cancer through clinical trials and studies tissue samples.
This project tries to find out what drives cancer cachexia, a wasting syndrome with body weight loss.
This project tests base editing as a treatment for spinal muscular atrophy in mice.
This project builds tools that combine brain MRI data and AI to predict key factors in brain diseases.
This project uses deep learning to improve the quality of reconstructed medical images.
This project studies the clinical, ethical, legal, and economic questions raised by genomic newborn screening.
This project studies the mobility needs of veterans with disabilities and plans technology research on wheelchairs and scooters.
This project studies how two transcription factors control the identity and function of a type of T cell.
This project builds a platform that maps proteins in curved membrane nanodomains that control cardiac signaling.
This project tests whether somatic variants in gene coding and gene regulatory regions contribute to the risk of autism spectrum disorder.
